goal: Ensure wallet dump fails with an error if writes fail instead of silently succeeding
Prevents leaving behind a truncated, corrupted dump file when filesystem writes fail
reviewability: Author has been silent for 90 days, so review feedback may wait a long time for a response
agreement: Substantive support with all suggestions addressed
Verified that disk durability is guaranteed across crashes and test coverage is added (pablomartin4btc)

categories.name: wallet
why: P2 because it prevents silent backup corruption when a dump runs out of disk space or hits I/O errors
Users would otherwise be left with a truncated dump file while the tool reports success
